name: MR. PIKE'S COLLAR
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. Six years uncollected at the laundry. It goes round the raccoon's neck in Act III.
iconPending: reference/objects-second-pass/brief.md asks the image session for it (errata 250); the panel draws its labelled box meanwhile.

LOOK_AT.say: A detachable collar, starched to the hardness of a plate. PIKE, E., inked inside it, in two scripts.
repeat: All that while in a box, and not a crease. Mr. Sheng starches for the long term.
It was washed for a man who never came for it. It is the cleanest thing I carry, and it is not mine.

LISTEN_TO.say: It knocks, when I flick it. Linen should not knock.
repeat: Nothing. It is standing to attention.
A dry creak, when I bend it. I have stopped bending it.
